_readme: Template for search.json in this folder. Copy it to setup/search.json, delete what you don't need, keep valid JSON.
Keys starting with '_' are comments and are ignored. Full option lists: docs/SEARCH_OPTIONS.md.
Easiest way to get a search_state: set filters on hiringcafe.com, copy the searchState= value from the URL, URL-decode it.

search_state._searchQuery: Free-text query, same as the site's search box.
search_state._workplaceTypes: Subset of: Remote, Hybrid, Onsite, Field. Omit for all.
search_state._commitmentTypes: Subset of: Full Time, Part Time, Contract, Internship, Temporary, Seasonal, Volunteer.
search_state._seniorityLevel: Subset of: No Prior Experience Required, Entry Level, Mid Level, Senior Level.
search_state._dateFetchedPastNDays: Number of days since hiring.cafe fetched the posting (1 = today, 2, 3, 7, 14, 30...). Site default 121. Also accepts {"from": "2026-09-01", "to": "2026-09-15"}.
search_state._locations: List of place objects from https://hiringcafe.com/api/searchLocation?query=<text> (use the placeDetail part). The one below is the site's built-in 'United States'. Omit entirely to let hiring.cafe pick your country from your IP.
search_state._excludedWorkplaceLocations: Same shape as locations; jobs there are dropped.
search_state._roleYoeRange: [min, max] years of role experience; max 20 means 20+. Default [0, 20].
search_state._excludeIfRoleYoeIsNotSpecified: true drops postings that don't state years of experience.
search_state._securityClearances: Subset of: None, Confidential, Secret, Top Secret, Top Secret/SCI, Public Trust, Interim Clearances, Other. ['None'] = only jobs with no clearance.
search_state._roleTypes: Subset of: Individual Contributor, People Manager.
search_state._benefitsAndPerks: Subset of: Generous Paid Time Off, Four Day Work Week, 401k Matching, Generous Parental Leave, Retirement Plan, Tuition Reimbursement, Visa Sponsorship, Relocation Assistance. 'Visa Sponsorship' has many false negatives.
search_state._jobTitleQuery: Text that must appear in the title. _jobDescriptionQuery / _technologyKeywordsQuery / _requirementsKeywordsQuery work the same on other fields.
search_state._companyNames / _excludedCompanyNames: Lists of company names (as shown on the site).
search_state._industries / _excludedIndustries / _dep: Lists of the site's industry / department labels.
search_state._organizationTypes: Subset of: private, public, non-profit, government, cooperative / mutual.
search_state._companySizeRanges: List of [min, max] headcount pairs, e.g. [[1, 50], [51, 200]].
search_state._compensation: currency {"label":"USD","value":"USD"}, frequency {"label":"Yearly","value":"Yearly"}, minCompensationLowEnd / minCompensationHighEnd / maxCompensationLowEnd / maxCompensationHighEnd numbers, restrictJobsToTransparentSalaries true|false.
search_state._degree: associatesDegreeRequirements / bachelorsDegreeRequirements / mastersDegreeRequirements / doctorateDegreeRequirements: subset of Required, Preferred, Not Mentioned. *FieldsOfStudy: lists of field names.
search_state._languageRequirements: List of languages; languageRequirementsOperator OR|AND; excludeJobsWithAdditionalLanguageRequirements true|false.
search_state._work_conditions: physicalEnvironments (Office, Outdoor, Vehicle, Industrial, Customer-Facing); physicalLaborIntensity / oralCommunicationLevels / computerUsageLevels / cognitiveDemandLevels (Low, Medium, High); physicalPositions (Sitting, Standing); airTravelRequirement / landTravelRequirement (None, Minimal, Moderate, Extensive); morningShiftWork / eveningShiftWork / overnightShiftWork (Required, Optional, Not Indicated); onCallRequirements (None, Occasional (once a month or less), Regular (once a week or more)); weekendAvailabilityRequired / holidayAvailabilityRequired / overtimeRequired (Doesn't Matter, Yes, No).
search_state._encouragedToApply: Subset of: Military Veterans, Fair Chance.
search_state._sortBy: default (relevance), date (newest), date_asc, compensation_desc, compensation_asc, experience_asc, experience_desc. resume_match_desc / personalization_desc need a logged-in account.
search_state._account_only: hideJobTypes (Hidden, Saved, Applied, Viewed), degenMode, degenModeCategories, activitySignals need a hiring.cafe login and do nothing here.

rules._readme: Applied locally after fetching. Every rule is optional; remove it or set null to disable.
rules._require_countries: Job must list at least one of these ISO country codes (from the posting's workplace_countries).
rules._require_categories: hiring.cafe job_category must be one of these. Seen values: Software Development, Engineering, Quality Assurance, Information Technology, Research and Development (R&D), Data and Analytics, Customer Service, Project and Program Management, ...
rules._title_include: Title must contain at least one of these (case-insensitive).
rules._title_exclude: Title must contain none of these.
rules._max_min_yoe: Drop if the posting's minimum years of experience is above this.
rules._exclude_security_clearance: Drop postings that need any security clearance.
rules._max_age_hours: Drop postings whose estimated publish date is older than this many hours. null = off.
